engines.comment: Bounded to Node 22: the vendored xchain-vm optional dependency is the consensus runtime, which pins process.versions.modules to 127, so a contract read served from another engine is not the value the fleet committed. isolated-vm 6.2.0 ships prebuilt bindings for Node 22 (abi127) and Node 24 (abi137) alike, so a newer major installs rather than failing; being optional, an install failure here is a SILENT skip that drops the contract-read paths at runtime instead of failing loudly. See .nvmrc.
